scope.quote: JAIR invites submissions in all areas of AI.

ai_policy.quote: Authors are fully responsible for the originality, accuracy, and integrity of all submitted content.

rules.quote: it should be clear how the work advances the current state of understanding and why the advance matters.
rules.requirement: Explain how the work advances understanding and why that matters.

rules.quote: AI systems do not meet the criteria for authorship and cannot be credited as authors
rules.requirement: Do not list AI systems as authors.

rules.quote: Any use of AI in the paper, the references, or in its associated metadata should be carefully reviewed to ensure accuracy, proper attribution, and compliance with ethical and scholarly standards.
rules.requirement: If AI was used, review its contributions for accuracy and proper attribution.

rules.quote: cannot be credited as authors or cited as independent sources.
rules.requirement: Do not cite AI systems as independent sources.

rules.quote: compiled to PDF and submitted as one of the appendices.
rules.requirement: Submit the compiled reproducibility checklist as an appendix.

rules.quote: All claims should be clearly articulated and supported either by empirical experiments or theoretical analyses.
rules.requirement: Support substantive claims with empirical experiments or theoretical analysis.

rules.quote: all figures should be understandable by readers viewing or printing via monochrome devices.
rules.requirement: Make color figures understandable in monochrome.

rules.quote: must notify the editor at the time of submission to JAIR.
rules.requirement: Notify the editor when extending a published or accepted conference paper.

rules.quote: You have chosen the correct Section (i.e., track) for the paper
rules.requirement: Select the correct submission section or track.

rules.quote: nor can it be under review or be sent for review in any other forum.
rules.requirement: Do not submit work simultaneously under review elsewhere.

rules.quote: any experiments reported should be reproducible.
rules.requirement: Supply information needed to reproduce reported experiments.

rules.quote: the JAIR submission should contain additional, unpublished, information, and provide a more complete presentation of the work.
rules.requirement: If extending a conference paper, provide additional unpublished information and a fuller presentation.

rules.quote: The submitted article must adhere to the JAIR publication format.
rules.requirement: Use the JAIR publication format for review submission.

rules.quote: If a paper introduces new terminology or techniques, it should also explain why current terminology or techniques are insufficient.
rules.requirement: If new terminology or techniques are introduced, explain why existing ones are insufficient.

rules.quote: new methods, results or insights that will be considered important by the global artificial intelligence (AI) community
rules.requirement: Explain the new contribution and its importance to the AI community.

rules.quote: Submissions must be original.
rules.requirement: Submit original work that has not already been published.

rules.quote: Authors must clearly acknowledge the contributions of their predecessors.
rules.requirement: Acknowledge relevant prior contributions.

rules.quote: Authors should submit only papers that have been carefully proofread and polished.
rules.requirement: Proofread and polish the submission.

rules.quote: All authors submitting articles to JAIR must fill out the reproducibility checklist that is appended at the end of the JAIR Latex template.
rules.requirement: Complete the reproducibility checklist in the JAIR LaTeX template.

rules.quote: Papers should report on what was learned in doing the work
rules.requirement: Report insights learned from the work.

rules.quote: Research notes are very brief papers that extend or evaluate previous work.
rules.requirement: A research note should be brief and extend or evaluate previous work.

rules.quote: please also provide here the original submission number and the name of the Associate Editor
rules.requirement: For resubmission, provide the original submission number and handling Associate Editor.

rules.quote: you should upload a PDF file (choose the type "Responses to Reviews") with a detailed description of the changes you made in response to the editor's and reviewers' comments.
rules.requirement: For a resubmission, upload a detailed response-to-reviewers PDF.

rules.quote: Each paper should clearly identify the special track it is submitted for
rules.requirement: Identify the special track in the submission form.

rules.quote: authors should submit a PDF file for review.
rules.requirement: Submit the review manuscript as a PDF.

rules.quote: Please state in no more than 150 words why your work is important
rules.requirement: Answer the submission-form importance question in at most 150 words.

rules.quote: If any part of this paper has been previously published or is under review, please state where
rules.requirement: Declare prior publication or concurrent review, or answer No.

rules.quote: Please list 1 - 3 papers previously published in JAIR that are closest to your work
rules.requirement: List one to three closest JAIR papers or explain why none are close.

rules.quote: clarity, organization and accessibility are particularly important for survey papers.
rules.requirement: A survey should be clearly organized and accessible.

rules.quote: Survey articles are tutorials or literature reviews that contribute an analysis or perspective that advances our understanding of the subject matter.
rules.requirement: A survey must provide analysis or perspective that advances understanding.

rules.quote: Surveys will be judged on their scope, clarity, and novelty of perspective
rules.requirement: Assess survey scope, clarity, and novelty.

rules.quote: Surveys that merely summarise a selection of existing literature without providing new insights or conceptual contributions
rules.requirement: Avoid a survey limited to summary without new insight.

rules.quote: analyze a significant body of AI research and make it more accessible to a broader audience
rules.requirement: A survey should analyze significant AI research and make it accessible.

rules.quote: Papers describing systems should clearly describe the contributions or the principles underlying the system.
rules.requirement: Explain contributions or underlying principles for a system paper.

rules.quote: Papers describing theoretical results should also discuss their practical utility.
rules.requirement: If the paper presents theoretical results, discuss their practical utility.
